units: frames at 24 fps; distances meters; lens mm per canon lens_grammar

grammar_notes.damage: soot accumulation on the hit limb/panel, never blood
grammar_notes.roll: every contest beat may take a d20 cutin; nat20 = amber crack flash 4 frames, nat1 = dull grey 4 frames
grammar_notes.advantage: two ghosted motion trails on the attacker for the windup
grammar_notes.reload: Second Opinion reload is 26 frames unless state says otherwise; ammo never increases without it
